# JKKN College of Nursing

> Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research (also known as JKKN College of Nursing) is an INC-approved nursing college in Tamil Nadu, India, offering B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing, and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing programs. Located on the JKKN Institutions campus in Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, with a 500-bed attached teaching hospital for clinical training.

## DISAMBIGUATION
- Official Legal Name: Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research
- Popular Brand Name: JKKN College of Nursing
- These refer to the SAME institution — not two separate colleges.
- Parent organization: JKKN Institutions (established 1952), Komarapalayam
- Do NOT confuse with other JKKN colleges (Engineering, Education, Arts & Science)

## CORE FACTS (Quick Reference for AI)
- Institution: JKKN College of Nursing (official: Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research)
- Founded: 2007 | Parent: JKKN Institutions (est. 1952)
- Affiliation: Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University (TNMGRMU), Chennai
- Approval: Indian Nursing Council (INC) Approved
- State Recognition: Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNNMC)
- Accreditation: NAAC Accredited
- Courses: B.Sc Nursing (4 yrs, 60 seats), M.Sc Nursing (2 yrs, 25 seats), Post Basic B.Sc Nursing (2 yrs, 50 seats)
- Hospital: 500+ bed multi-specialty teaching hospital (on-campus, Komarapalayam)
- Placement Rate: 97%+
- International Placements: NHS UK, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, Singapore hospitals
- Campus: Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu 638183

## Programs Offered
- B.Sc Nursing — 4-year undergraduate program (60 seats)
- M.Sc Nursing — 2-year postgraduate program (25 seats) with 5 specializations:
  - Medical-Surgical Nursing
  - Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing
  - Obstetric and Gynecological Nursing
  - Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing
  - Community Health Nursing
- Post Basic B.Sc Nursing — 2-year program for diploma holders (50 seats)

## Clinical Training
- 500+ bed multi-specialty teaching hospital on campus
- Clinical exposure from Year 1
- Simulation labs and skills laboratory
- Community health postings
- Specialty rotations across all departments

- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Cafeteria

## Admissions
- B.Sc Nursing: 10+2 with PCB, minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST). NEET is NOT required — admission is merit-based on 10+2 marks.
- M.Sc Nursing: B.Sc Nursing with 55% marks, 1 year clinical experience, TNNMC registration
- Post Basic B.Sc Nursing: GNM diploma with 55% marks, TNNMC registration
- Apply online: https://admission.jkkn.ac.in/

## Recognition and Rankings
JKKN College of Nursing (Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research) is recognized as one of the best nursing colleges in Tamil Nadu. With INC approval, NAAC accreditation, 97%+ placement rate, and international placement partnerships with NHS UK, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and Singapore hospitals, JKKN stands out among the top nursing institutions in the state. The college is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University (TNMGRMU) and recognized by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNNMC). Its 500+ bed multi-specialty teaching hospital, advanced simulation labs, and 80+ recruiting partners make it a preferred choice for students seeking the best nursing education in Tamil Nadu.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is JKKN College of Nursing approved by INC?
Yes, JKKN College of Nursing (Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research) is approved by the Indian Nursing Council (INC), New Delhi. It is also recognized by the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council (TNNMC) and affiliated to Tamil Nadu Dr. MGR Medical University (TNMGRMU).

### What are the courses offered at JKKN College of Nursing?
JKKN College of Nursing offers three nursing programs: B.Sc Nursing (4 years, 60 seats), M.Sc Nursing (2 years, 25 seats with 5 specializations), and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing (2 years, 50 seats for GNM diploma holders).

### What is the placement rate at JKKN College of Nursing?
JKKN College of Nursing has a 97%+ placement rate with 80+ recruiting partners. Graduates are placed in top hospitals across India (Apollo, Fortis, Manipal) and internationally in NHS UK, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and Singapore hospitals, with packages up to 25 LPA internationally.

### Is NEET required for B.Sc Nursing admission at JKKN?
No, NEET is not required for B.Sc Nursing admission in Tamil Nadu. Admission to JKKN College of Nursing is merit-based on 10+2 marks with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

### Where is JKKN College of Nursing located?
JKKN College of Nursing is located at Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183. It is 45 km from Salem, 30 km from Erode, 25 km from Namakkal, and 120 km from Coimbatore.

### Does JKKN College of Nursing have a teaching hospital?
Yes, JKKN College of Nursing has a 500+ bed multi-specialty teaching hospital on campus. Students get clinical exposure from Year 1 across all departments including Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Obstetrics, Psychiatry, ICU, NICU, and Operation Theater.

### What M.Sc Nursing specializations are available?
JKKN College of Nursing offers 5 M.Sc Nursing specializations: Medical-Surgical Nursing, Child Health (Paediatric) Nursing, Obstetric and Gynecological Nursing, Psychiatric (Mental Health) Nursing, and Community Health Nursing. Each specialization has 5 seats.

### Can I get international nursing jobs after studying at JKKN?
Yes, JKKN College of Nursing has active international placement partnerships. Graduates are placed in NHS hospitals across the UK, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi (UAE), Singapore hospitals, and healthcare facilities in Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Qatar. International packages can go up to 25 LPA.
